plan.title: Sunday after the step: proof, a short reflection, then a natural turn to the week and the week talk

context.text: Chapter 6 tonight, Maya: 8 pm on the couch, about 20 minutes, phone in the kitchen. Then a quick voice recap.

transcript.text: [voice: Done, chapter six. The make it obvious part clicked, I left the book on my pillow this morning so I'd see it tonight.]

Maya, that's the idea in action! You didn't just understand "make it obvious," you put the book on your pillow and used it. Chapter 6 is done 📚 When you saw the book there tonight, did it make starting feel easier than other nights?
yeah and phone was in the kitchen again, zero buzzing

Zero buzzing is a big win, Maya. Zooming out, here's the progress you made this week:
• 6 of 7 days done in full, with a voice recap each time, chapters 1 to 6
• Today you used "make it obvious" by putting the book on your pillow, and it made starting easier
• Phone in the kitchen kept your reading buzz-free, and you got back on track right after Thursday's dinner with friends
• You're through chapter 6 with 22 days left to finish Atomic Habits by Nov 30

What do you want to push on next week: reading a bit more each night, or keeping this pace and locking in the habit?

Got it, Maya, good week. For Monday, let's keep the same rhythm: chapter 7 at 8 pm on the couch, about 20 minutes, with your phone in the kitchen. Then send a voice recap that includes one cue in your home you could use. Work for you?
honestly the dishes thing, it doesn't even feel like effort now. this week I want to get through it faster

Love that, Maya. The dishes cue is doing its job, so let's speed it up. Tomorrow is chapters 7 and 8 on the couch at 8 pm, about 30 minutes, phone in the kitchen. Then send a voice recap that includes one cue in your home you could use. Work for you?
Locked in, Maya. Two chapters tomorrow at 8 pm, and you've already shown you can do this. Go get some rest 💪
